notes: AI Teacher Network: providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Fireworks or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint) are connected once, verified against the real API, and their models are discovered live. No model list or price is hardcoded anywhere: specs appear only where the provider reports them and prices only where you enter them.

Credential security: API keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage, returned only as a last-four hint plus a short fingerprint, redacted from provider errors, and refused outright when CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not configured on the backend.

Teacher Selection Studio: modes A single, B multiple independent answers, C teacher + separate evaluator, D competition, E specialised by domain, with hard per-run budgets (requests, tokens, spend, concurrency) and a daily cap per provider that stops a run mid-flight and records why.

Knowledge Distillation and Dataset Quality Review: instruction/QA/coding/multilingual/summarization/classification/preference tasks, per-record provenance (provider, model, request ID, tokens, latency), duplicate and near-duplicate filtering, language and format validation, contradiction and teacher-disagreement analysis, human approval, and conversion of accepted records only into chat JSONL / Alpaca / QA / classification / preference datasets.

Student Model Studio: inspects the real architecture (CORPUS models are instantiated and counted; Hugging Face models are read through AutoConfig) and gates SFT, LoRA, QLoRA, DPO and continued training on the libraries and hardware that are actually present.

Training Intelligence: architecture, training configuration, dataset analytics, hardware telemetry, live optimizer-step metrics and charts are all read from persisted rows; anything the runtime could not measure is shown as Unavailable.
API Usage and Budgets: per-provider requests, failures, rate-limit errors, input/output/cached tokens, estimated spend, average latency and last request, with owner-configured hard limits.
howToVerify: GET <frontend-url>/version.json — the deployed buildId must equal the buildId committed in frontend/version.json on main.
